It may sound macabre, but for morgue supervisor Gireyev, dead people are the love of his life. Having begun his career as a gravedigger at a Moscow cemetery in imperial Russia before the revolution, Gireyev's career has involved exhuming bodies, destroying the corpses of people killed by the Brown Plague, and overseeing funerals for unknown soldiers after the war. He rarely makes jokes, but is "more comfortable with the dead, since no one's ever had his life ruined by a corpse."

Nicknamed "Koschevna" after Koschey, a character from Russian folklore whose soul is hidden within a series of nested items, Khodyukova matches her facetious moniker to a tee. Not even an entire team of Complex and project managers could vie with her when it comes to accounting skills. She is particularly concerned with her social rating, but always endeavors to work efficiently enough to top the chart. Accounts payable, expense reports, endless contracts—she mentally catalogs all this information with such perfection that Professor Zakharov once joked that Kollektiv's system should not be built on Neuropolymers, but planned by Nonna Khodyukova.

Nyukhov was assigned to his current position immediately after the complex was created.
